description: This file defines the Response class in the AWS CRT HTTP namespace, representing an HTTP response with methods for marshalling, unmarshalling, and accessing the status code.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, extending the Message class with a status code and static methods for marshalling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Response with method, path, query, headers, and status code.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the Response object for transmission.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes data into a Response object.

methods.name: status_code
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.
